propositions: Single JSON object replies are decoded twice via _all_json_objects and json.loads, creating identical-but-nonidentical Pydantic candidates that falsely trigger ambiguity warnings
Identity check (is not) incorrectly flags semantically equal validated objects as conflicting when they are separately constructed instances
Ordinary native structured outputs emit false multiple-candidate warnings despite first and last candidates being semantically identical
Deduplicating value-equal candidates before validation preserves discovery order, eliminates false warnings, and retains last-valid-wins for genuinely distinct candidates
Runtime probe confirmed candidate_count=2, candidate_equal=true, validated_equal=true, validated_identical=false for single-object replies
Fix adds deduplication in _candidate_dicts to retain first value-equal survivor, resolving false ambiguity without altering result boundary or caller behavior
